productConcept.name: Strata
productConcept.description: A geospatial subsurface data platform that unifies borehole logs, CPT profiles, seismic survey outputs, and structural load models into a single precision analysis environment for infrastructure engineers.
productConcept.rationale: The cerulean-draft design system's aesthetic — cold precise palette (midnight navy #1b1b37, cool teal #63cabe, calibration-grade violet #b79cff), geometric Syne typeface at 0.06em letter-spacing, instrument-panel color structure, and clinical precision vocabulary — directly maps to the geospatial engineering software domain. The teal and violet function as data-labeling colors, the midnight as depth/subsurface register. The concept avoids the blocked list and the obvious (no machining brand, no watch company, no SaaS productivity tool) — instead using the precision vocabulary to represent a niche technical discipline (geotechnical site investigation) where the combination of precision, data layering, and clinical exactness is literally the product.
